method: F_ir = tokenizer_r.count(render_message(atomize(doc_i))); F* = median_r(median_i F_ir); B1=round(F*/2); B2=round(F*/1.5); B3=200
independence_note: B* was recomputed from the two surviving receivers' own per-receiver median token counts, which are receiver-specific and unaffected by panel membership. Only the outer median changes. The result coincides with the historical Muse-panel value of 89; this is an independent recalculation that happens to agree, NOT a reuse of the Muse-calibrated constant.
reverification_required: harness_budget_calibration.py --receivers nvidia_gpt_oss_20b nvidia_nemotron3_super_120b_a12b  (must be run on the Mac under Python 3.12; this file records the arithmetic only)
